intent.raw: define design and plan a new governed evidence-repair package
intent.objective: Create an append-only generation-3 route for atomic target discrimination, isolated browser evidence, usefulness measurement, deterministic evaluation, and independent closeout.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The plan defaults to serialized Task Sessions because protected handles and reviewed outputs are sequential gates. Optional parallel mutation runs require later explicit authorization.

boundaries.contract: Reference protected predecessors by exact path, digest, record, and generation handle; never rewrite them.

boundaries.from_owner: closed UI-repair corpus and dossier policy
boundaries.contract: Import stable DEFER/missing handles only; do not rerun policy or infer portability.
No dependency installation or browser download occurs without an explicit recorded option; no non-browser fallback may emit browser evidence.
Read pinned slices and generate local harness files; write no Savvy file.
Freeze the overlay before evaluator output exists; evaluator consumes but cannot revise judgments.

boundaries.to_owner: DS-D1, DS-D8, pattern and promotion owners
boundaries.contract: No calibration, browser, usefulness, suite, audit, or Inventory output decides identity, type, relationship, pattern, candidate, activation, or promotion state.

state_namespaces.write_policy: new results plus one append-only index entry

steps.name: Author Define Design And Plan Package

inputs.ref: generation-2 closeout audit and UI-repair successor closeout

outputs.ref: SPEC, GLOSSARY, ARCHITECTURE, IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN, WORK-PACK and dispatch

stop_conditions: block silent predecessor, UI policy, source, or authority mutation

steps.name: Freeze Protected Imports And Atomic Targets

outputs.ref: protected import and atomic target contracts, validators, negatives and receipt

stop_conditions: block wrong predecessor, target outcome leakage, non-total target set, or protected drift

steps.name: Resolve Browser Runtime And Contracts

outputs.ref: runtime descriptor and browser observation contracts

steps.evidence_artifact: SWU-CDSC3-002 decision and Task Session receipt
stop_conditions: block unapproved install/download, absent runtime, or screenshot-only evidence contract

steps.name: Prove Source-Derived Browser Baseline

inputs.ref: approved browser runtime and source manifest

outputs.ref: browser harness and baseline equivalence receipt

stop_conditions: block source drift, untraceable behavior, mount failure, or baseline mismatch

steps.name: Observe Permitted Browser Mutation
stop_conditions: block edit leak, incomplete structured output, nondeterminism, or adjudication claim

steps.name: Observe Breaking Browser Mutation
stop_conditions: block guard/commit conflation, edit leak, incomplete output, nondeterminism, or adjudication claim

steps.name: Measure Downstream Decision Differential

outputs.ref: preregistered catalog, planners and D receipt

stop_conditions: block circular planner inputs, nondeterminism, or coercion of empty D

steps.name: Freeze Atomic Adjudication And Projection
stop_conditions: block target/explanation drift, incomplete matrix, hidden partial/dispute, dropped uncertainty, or evaluator call

steps.name: Evaluate And Append Generation 3

inputs.ref: accepted projection and exact generation-2 tail

outputs.ref: F3/suite results, provenance, run receipt and generation-3 entry

stop_conditions: block projection drift, non-total outcome, wrong predecessor, duplicate append, replay drift, or authority route

steps.name: Independently Replay And Close

outputs.ref: fresh replay, authority audit, Inventory read model and closeout receipt

stop_conditions: block any byte, handle, target, browser, receipt, provenance, Inventory, source, or authority failure

gates.condition: Define, six-view Design, high-complexity Plan, dispatch, and Distill artifacts validate.
Six parent-derived targets and exact protected imports pass all negative vectors.
A reproducible real-browser runtime path is explicitly approved and frozen before download/install or evidence.
Source-derived browser baseline is total, equivalent, traceable, and deterministic.
Permitted, breaking, and D receipts are total, isolated, deterministic, and interpretation-free.
Thirty-six reviewed coordinates, uncertainty, and target/evidence provenance are valid before evaluation.
Frozen evaluator returns a total result and generation 3 appends once after the exact generation-2 tail.
No artifact claims identity, type, relationship, pattern, portability, candidate, activation, or promotion authority.

observability.receipt_shape: WORK-PACK.md and task-local Task Session receipt contracts

promotion_guardrails: Atomic target decomposition is an evidence representation, not a new ontology.
Browser equivalence is local behavior evidence, not portability or identity.
A nonempty downstream decision differential is not promotion-worthy usefulness by itself.
Calibration PASS validates the rubric only and cannot admit a compound type or UI meta-type.
Inventory is a read model and cannot mutate authority.
